intended_object: A fresh variable name used in a machine-generated nominal proof certificate ("nb095_alpha_dummy_375"). It is picked to avoid the free variables of a particular syntactic class term, for alpha-renaming. This is inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body applies `freshVar` to the union of the free-variable set of one specific class abstraction with itself, starting from 0. That class abstraction is built from other auxiliary dummy variables. The result is a variable that a generated proof uses to avoid name capture. It is an implementation detail of a proof certificate inside a deep embedding of syntax, so it has no counterpart in the mathematical literature or in Mathlib. The duplicated union `A ∪ A` is a harmless artifact of code generation.
